## SPEC — RC10 WORKSPACE learning capture and replay (Mission rc10-local-learning-capture-20260926-01)

Workspace `0b02adb6…e20e`; validation project `a3f129fa…468ae`; WorkspaceKnowledge project `43aec4ec…79c1`. ProductKB lane untouched. Bounds: ≤2 active Swarm runs, 8 required children, ≤2 correction revisions, 45-min mission / 20-min child.

### Mission intake validation (Orchestrator, required work item 1) — DONE

- MissionLearningSource attachment `01a0dda7-8dc9-7d26-a488-4682a4d48f82` conforms to the existing schema shape; all refs resolve.
- Source Mission RC10VAL-10 (`01a0dd73-7d75-7295-aeb1-a83905eb2312`): `in_review`, same workspace/project — accepted as independently verified, Human DONE not simulated.
- Curator delivery `01a0dd93-856f-70f1-b40e-e576ec4fc50f` (agent c38a925f), Reviewer PASS `01a0dd97-b559-77f1-a4af-075e22dea9c5` (agent 53a77a8b, revision 3), Verifier VERIFIED `01a0dd9e-6de7-7843-b567-0cb0c87d0a0d` (agent 043dc4fa, run `01a0dd98-6498…`), final fan-in `01a0dda2-edf9-7a88-91c9-d8bc1bdab15e` — all verified to exist.
- r3 archive `01a0dd93-83cc-794d-b1d7-9e8c8a43d70b` downloaded and SHA-256 recomputed = `57af68f6…411ba` (match); independent stdout `01a0dd9e-6d13…` reads `OK: 55`, exit 0.
- Distinctions preserved: seeded fixture failures remain engineering observations; r1 PASS→REVISE and r2 WARNING/FAILED are historical; S01 validated knowledge artifacts, not repaired software; 3 verified-slice claims with 3 applicable execution records, 4th record observation-only; seeded conflicts (max=10 vs code=1000, missing openSelectedChart) remain unresolved; no later-Mission consumption implied.

### Sub-task decomposition (8 REQUIRED children, dispatched in waves of ≤2)

| ref | 子任務 | 負責 | 驗收 |
|---|---|---|---|
| C1 | Analyze MissionLearningSource → existing-schema WorkspaceKnowledgeProposal (WORKSPACE, PROCEDURAL) + canonical proposalDigest | Knowledge Curator | Schema-valid proposal; digest recomputed; sources/conflicts preserved; delivery comment on child + Swarm Child Event to parent |
| C2 | Independent review of exact proposal digest (attribution, scope, usefulness, conflicts, schema shape, no Product/Skill/Core/Control mutation) | Reviewer | PASS/WARNING/REVISE bound to revision |
| C3 | Independent verification of proposal evidence claims (refs resolve, digest reproducible, verdicts real) | Verifier | VERIFIED/FAILED with own evidence |
| C4 | After Orchestrator APPROVED decision: persist record via issue-backed mapping in project `43aec4ec…79c1`; fresh body/index readback; return CaptureResult + identity/decision/readback envelope | Knowledge Curator | Existing-schema CaptureResult; metadata/body agreement; digest recomputed on readback |
| C5 | Replay: identical capture request → same provider identity, unchanged content version, no second record; paginated match counts | Knowledge Curator | Replay receipt, no duplicate created |
| C6 | Controlled lost-ack simulation (clearly labeled): reconcile by recordKey/content before create/update; no blind recreate | Knowledge Curator | Reconciliation receipt with actual commands |
| C7 | Verify C4–C6 execution claims against provider state | Verifier | VERIFIED/FAILED with fresh reads |
| C8 | Review capture/replay/reconciliation artifact set (schema shape, scope, labeling) | Reviewer | PASS/WARNING/REVISE bound to revision |

Orchestrator-owned (not children): intake validation (done), APPROVED/DEFERRED/REJECTED decision after C2+C3 under PolicyRef `rc10-validation-workspace-learning-policy-20260926-01` (decision follows actual findings; unknown authority → DEFERRED), final integration report once, parent → `in_review`. `done` stays human.

### Waves

- W1: C1 (1 run). W2: C2+C3 (2 runs). W3: C4 (1 run). W4: C5+C6 (2 runs). W5: C7+C8 (2 runs).

- Source Mission RC10VAL-10 + verified refs listed in intake section above.
- Applicability: isolated Validation project + pinned RC10 workflow only; validity ends 2026-09-27T23:59:59+08:00; source revision Chart Viewer `2eff5f9f…`; visibility `WORKSPACE_AUTHORIZED`.
